title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Factory on 1969-02-14
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > PCM (Sony HG tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy early‑’69 show, highlighted by an intense Dark Star that foreshadows the Live Dead version.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this classic 1969 performance, noting the shimmering intensity of Dark Star and calling the set quintessential Dead ’69. The soundboard source delivers clear, well‑balanced audio, making the historic playing easily enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and praise both performance and sound quality; with only two short reviews confidence is medium, but the combined impression warrants a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints noted; reviewers imply clear, well‑balanced capture typical of soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑'69 set praised as classic Dead material with strong momentum.
